Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_Enabled_tooltip: When off, the minimap stays open without a watch and map watches don't drain.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_MinimapRule_too:
No watch needed: the minimap stays open.
Watch required: wear a map watch with charge.
Minimap off: nobody can open the minimap.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_FullHours_toolt: Real time, 1 to 720 hours: how long a full battery keeps a map watch running.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainOffline_to:
Off by default: the battery doesn't drain while the player is offline.
When on, the offline time is deducted on the next login (up to 30 days).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainPaused_too: Off by default: the battery doesn't drain while a single-player game is paused. Multiplayer servers don't pause.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_RulePoi_tooltip:
Resource point icons and legend; category search is never restricted (Directory Module).
No watch needed: always available.
Watch required: works with any worn map watch that has charge.
Module required: the matching module must be installed in a working slot of a worn, charged watch.
Off: nobody can use it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_RuleNav_tooltip:
Road routes, multi-stop trips, route home, and the direction arrow to off-screen targets (Positioning Module; an AutoDrive GPS navigator on you or in your vehicle also counts).
No watch needed: always available.
Watch required: works with any worn map watch that has charge.
Module required: the matching module must be installed in a working slot of a worn, charged watch.
Off: nobody can use it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_RuleShare_toolt:
Sharing targets with your faction, plus teammate icons (Comms Module, Long-Range Comms Module, or Relay Core). The server checks each recipient when it forwards a share.
No watch needed: always available.
Watch required: works when both the sharer and the recipient wear a map watch that has charge, at any distance.
Module required: both the sharer and the recipient need a comms-type module in a working slot of a worn, charged watch, and must be within comm range (the larger of their two ranges; no limit if either has a Relay Core).
Off: nobody can use it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_RuleScan_toolti:
Icons for nearby vehicles and animals (Scanner Module).
No watch needed: always available.
Watch required: works with any worn map watch that has charge.
Module required: the matching module must be installed in a working slot of a worn, charged watch.
Off: nobody can use it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_RuleZombie_tool:
Nearby zombie positions and zombie heat (Detector Module: minimap only; Military Detector Module: both maps).
No watch needed: always available.
Watch required: works with any worn map watch that has charge.
Module required: the matching module must be installed in a working slot of a worn, charged watch.
Off: nobody can use it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotExt_tooltip:
Accepts General modules.
Free: available on every watch.
Unlock Card: use one unlock card to open it permanently. It's tied to the player's account, so it still counts on a different map watch.
Economy: buy or rent it with Minidoracat Economy money (prices and rental settings below); uses unlock cards when the server has no Economy or it is too old.
Disabled: cannot be opened. Modules already installed there are disabled and use no power; you can remove them at any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAdv_tooltip:
Accepts General and Advanced modules.
Free: available on every watch.
Unlock Card: use one unlock card to open it permanently. It's tied to the player's account, so it still counts on a different map watch.
Economy: buy or rent it with Minidoracat Economy money (prices and rental settings below); uses unlock cards when the server has no Economy or it is too old.
Disabled: cannot be opened. Modules already installed there are disabled and use no power; you can remove them at any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotCore_toolti:
Accepts General, Advanced, and Core modules.
Free: available on every watch.
Unlock Card: use one unlock card to open it permanently. It's tied to the player's account, so it still counts on a different map watch.
Economy: buy or rent it with Minidoracat Economy money (prices and rental settings below); uses unlock cards when the server has no Economy or it is too old.
Disabled: cannot be opened. Modules already installed there are disabled and use no power; you can remove them at any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddon: Access for slots added by other mods
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddon_toolt:
Added by other mods through the API; uses Expansion Slot Unlock Cards when unlock cards are required.
Free: available on every watch.
Unlock Card: use one unlock card to open it permanently. It's tied to the player's account, so it still counts on a different map watch.
Economy: buy or rent it with Minidoracat Economy money (prices and rental settings below); uses unlock cards when the server has no Economy or it is too old.
Disabled: cannot be opened. Modules already installed there are disabled and use no power; you can remove them at any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotExtBuy_tool: When the opening method is Economy, players can buy it outright with Minidoracat Economy money and keep it for good. Tied to the player's account.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotExtBuyPrice: Currency is set in "Paid slot currency". Default 400.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotExtRent_too: When the opening method is Economy, players can pay rent to open it for a while. When the rental ends the slot stops at once; installed modules stay on the watch, use no power, and can be removed any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotExtRentPric: Default 60. Changing it pauses auto-renew for players who agreed to the old price until they agree again (players are only charged what they agreed to).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAdvBuy_tool: When the opening method is Economy, players can buy it outright with Minidoracat Economy money and keep it for good. Tied to the player's account.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAdvBuyPrice: Currency is set in "Paid slot currency". Default 1200.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAdvRent_too: When the opening method is Economy, players can pay rent to open it for a while. When the rental ends the slot stops at once; installed modules stay on the watch, use no power, and can be removed any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAdvRentPric: Default 150. Changing it pauses auto-renew for players who agreed to the old price until they agree again (players are only charged what they agreed to).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotCoreBuy_too: When the opening method is Economy, players can buy it outright with Minidoracat Economy money and keep it for good. Tied to the player's account.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotCoreBuyPric: Currency is set in "Paid slot currency". Default 2400.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotCoreRent_to: When the opening method is Economy, players can pay rent to open it for a while. When the rental ends the slot stops at once; installed modules stay on the watch, use no power, and can be removed any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotCoreRentPri: Default 300. Changing it pauses auto-renew for players who agreed to the old price until they agree again (players are only charged what they agreed to).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddonBuy_to: When the opening method is Economy, players can buy it outright with Minidoracat Economy money and keep it for good. Tied to the player's account.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddonBuyPri: Currency is set in "Paid slot currency". Default 600.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddonRent_t: When the opening method is Economy, players can pay rent to open it for a while. When the rental ends the slot stops at once; installed modules stay on the watch, use no power, and can be removed any time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddonRentPr: Default 80. Changing it pauses auto-renew for players who agreed to the old price until they agree again (players are only charged what they agreed to).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_PayCurrency_too: All paid slot prices use this currency. Changing it pauses agreed auto-renewals until players agree again.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_PayRentDays: Paid slots: days per rental period
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_PayRentDays_too: How long one rental or renewal lasts, in real days. Changing it pauses agreed auto-renewals until players agree again.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_PayRetryHours_t: A slot stops the moment its rental ends. If auto-renew can't charge (not enough money), it retries every hour within this window and turns the slot back on once paid; after the window auto-renew is switched off. 0 = give up at once with no retry. During the window the rental still counts, so players can renew but not start a new rental. Applies to periods paid after the change.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_PayReminderHour: Paid slots: reminder before the end (hours)
How long before a rental ends the player is reminded. 0 = no reminder. Applies to periods paid after the change.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_PayAutoRenew_to: Players can let rentals renew automatically from their wallet. Turning this off stops charging agreed auto-renewals.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_NeedScrewdriver: On by default, matching how vanilla handles installing and removing electronic parts. When off, no tool is needed.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_ScanRadius_tool:
How far the Scanner Module shows vehicles and animals.
The actual range never exceeds the minimap's view distance setting. Only applies when the feature rule is "Module required".
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DetectRadius_to:
How far the Detector Module shows zombie positions and heat (minimap only).
The actual range never exceeds the minimap's view distance setting. Only applies when the feature rule is "Module required".
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_MilDetectRadius:
How far the Military Detector Module shows zombie positions and heat (minimap and world map).
The actual range never exceeds the minimap's view distance setting. Only applies when the feature rule is "Module required".
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_CommRange_toolt:
How far faction sharing reaches with the Comms Module.
Measured from the sharer to the recipient, using the larger of their two ranges; no limit if either has a Relay Core. Only applies when the faction sharing rule is "Module required".
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LongCommRange_t:
How far faction sharing reaches with the Long-Range Comms Module.
Measured from the sharer to the recipient, using the larger of their two ranges; no limit if either has a Relay Core. Only applies when the faction sharing rule is "Module required".
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainLedger_too:
Extra power the Directory Module uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainGPS_toolti:
Extra power the Positioning Module uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainComm_toolt:
Extra power the Comms Module uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainScan_toolt:
Extra power the Scanner Module uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainDetect_too:
Extra power the Detector Module uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainMilDetect_:
Extra power the Military Detector Module uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainLongComm_t:
Extra power the Long-Range Comms Module uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DrainRelay_tool:
Extra power the Relay Core uses on top of the minimap alone. For example, 25 means 1.25x drain.
No drain while its slot isn't open or its feature is disabled.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootValuTech: ValuTech Map Watch appears as loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootValuTech_to: Found in electronics stores, homes and gas station counters (common). When off it no longer spawns in containers (already spawned ones stay); zombie drops are set separately. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootPaws: Cat Paw Map Watch appears as loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootPaws_toolti: Found in toy stores, gift shops and kids' rooms (uncommon). When off it no longer spawns in containers (already spawned ones stay); zombie drops are set separately. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootNexus: Aurora Map Watch appears as loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootNexus_toolt: Found in electronics store watch cases and department stores (uncommon). When off it no longer spawns in containers (already spawned ones stay); zombie drops are set separately. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootSpiffo: Spiffo Kids' Watch appears as loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootSpiffo_tool: Found in Spiffo's restaurants and kids' rooms (uncommon). When off it no longer spawns in containers (already spawned ones stay); zombie drops are set separately. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootRanger: Ranger Tactical Watch appears as loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootRanger_tool: Found in military sites and police armories (rare). When off it no longer spawns in containers (already spawned ones stay); zombie drops are set separately. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootLuthex: Luthex Gold Watch appears as loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootLuthex_tool: Found in jewelry stores and upscale bedrooms (very rare). When off it no longer spawns in containers (already spawned ones stay); zombie drops are set separately. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootBB3000: BB-3000 Wrist Computer appears as loot
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootBB3000_tool: Found in military sites, bunkers and survival gear lockers (rare). When off it no longer spawns in containers (already spawned ones stay); zombie drops are set separately. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootModules_too: Electronics stores, electronics crates, military and police sites, survival gear lockers. Standard modules are more common; advanced and core modules are rare. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootCards_toolt: Rare: expansion cards in electronics stores, advanced cards at military and police sites, core cards in military bunkers. Turn off when you sell slots through the economy so players can't open them for free. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_AllowCraft_tool: Directory, Comms and Light Modules can be made from vanilla parts (screwdriver needed; the Electrical level is a separate option).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_ZombieDrops_too:
When a corpse is searched for the first time, items are added following the drop rules in the server settings file (10 rules by default, grouped by the zombie's outfit). Corpses that were already searched are not affected.
Rules file: Zomboid/Lua/MinidoracatWatch/server name/server-settings.json (sp_save name in singleplayer); a default one is written if it is missing.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_ZombieDropCap_t: When a zombie matches several rules, chances are rolled in order and stop once this many items dropped.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_RuleLight_toolt:
The Light Module's lamp: lights up the area around you; nearby players who can see you see it too (same as a vanilla flashlight).
Module required: the Light Module must sit in a valid slot of a worn, charged watch.
Off: nobody can turn the light on; lights that are on go out.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LightRadius_too: How far the light reaches when on. The same for every player.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LightDrain_tool:
Extra power used while the light is on, on top of the minimap alone and added to the other modules. For example, 100 means double drain.
No drain while off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_ChargeCar_toolt:
Off by default: batteries can only be swapped.
When on, a worn map watch slowly charges in real time while you sit in a vehicle with the engine running (driver or passenger). It doesn't drain while charging and doesn't use the vehicle's battery. No charging while offline.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_CarHours_toolti: Real time, 1 to 168 hours: roughly how long a vehicle takes to charge a watch from empty to full.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_ChargeHouse_too:
Off by default: batteries can only be swapped.
When on, a worn map watch slowly charges in real time while you're indoors where there's grid or generator power. It doesn't drain while charging and doesn't use generator fuel. No charging while offline.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_HouseHours_tool: Real time, 1 to 168 hours: roughly how long a powered building takes to charge a watch from empty to full.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootWatchAmount:
How often the seven map watch styles appear in containers. Each still appears in its usual places at its own rarity.
Very Low: a quarter of the recommended value; Low: half; Normal: recommended; High: double. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootModuleAmoun:
How often modules appear in containers; General modules are more common, Advanced and Core modules are rare.
Very Low: a quarter of the recommended value; Low: half; Normal: recommended; High: double. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_LootCardAmount_:
How often unlock cards appear in containers; the default is Very Low.
Very Low: a quarter of the recommended value; Low: half; Normal: recommended; High: double. Takes effect immediately.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_NeedBattery_too: On by default. When off, the watch never runs out: no drain, no charging, and no battery needed.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_DeadMode_toolti: What happens when the watch's battery is dead or missing: every feature turns off (default; the minimap shows "No Signal"), or only the minimap stays on (other features and modules still stop).
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_CraftLevel_tool: 0 to 10, default 3; 0 means no Electrical skill needed. The crafting window shows the new requirement.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotExtCard: Expansion Slot: also accept unlock cards
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotExtCard_too: When this slot is sold through the economy, players can also open it with an unlock card (permanent, bound to the account). Off by default.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAdvCard: Advanced Slot: also accept unlock cards
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAdvCard_too: When this slot is sold through the economy, players can also open it with an unlock card (permanent, bound to the account). Off by default.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotCoreCard: Core Slot: also accept unlock cards
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotCoreCard_to: When this slot is sold through the economy, players can also open it with an unlock card (permanent, bound to the account). Off by default.
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddonCard: Add-on slots: also accept unlock cards
Sandbox_MinidoracatWatch_SlotAddonCard_t: When this slot is sold through the economy, players can also open it with an unlock card (permanent, bound to the account). Off by default.
